description: Astro static framework layer — astro.config.mjs, Base layout, and index page wired for zero-JS static output.

defaults.headline: Starter Foundry landing page
defaults.subheadline: A fast, content-first static site built with Astro.

buildHints.whenToUse: Content-focused static sites (marketing, docs, blogs) where you want islands of interactivity without shipping a full SPA runtime.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `pnpm dev` — Astro's Vite dev server binds to http://localhost:4321 with HMR.
Pages live in `src/pages/` — every `.astro`, `.md`, or `.mdx` file becomes a route automatically.
Shared HTML shell is in `src/layouts/Base.astro`. Wrap each page with `<Base title="...">...</Base>`.
Build with `pnpm build` — emits fully static HTML/CSS/JS to `./dist/`. Preview with `pnpm preview`.
gotchas: Frontmatter in `.astro` files runs at BUILD time — browser globals (`window`, `document`) are not available there; put client code inside `<script>` tags or `client:*` directives.
To add a React/Vue/Svelte island you must install `@astrojs/<framework>` AND add it to `astro.config.mjs`'s `integrations` array — just importing a `.jsx` file silently fails.
`import.meta.env.PUBLIC_*` is the only env prefix exposed to client bundles — non-prefixed vars are build-time server-only.
architectureNotes: Astro ships ZERO JS by default — interactivity is opt-in per component via `client:load`, `client:idle`, `client:visible`, or `client:only`.
Output mode is `static` in astro.config.mjs — switch to `server` or `hybrid` only if SSR is actually needed.
